blocks.text: Principal quantum number n ki qeematein positive whole numbers (poore adad) 1, 2, 3, 4… hain, jinhen K, L, M, N… bhi kehte hain. Yeh Bohr ke hydrogen atom model ke orbit number jaisa hi hai. n orbital ka size aur energy batata hai.

blocks.title: Electron shell
blocks.text: Jin orbitals ka n ek jaisa ho, un ke majmooe (group) ko electron shell kehte hain.

n jitna bara, orbital ka electron nucleus se ausatan (average) utna door, aur orbital utna bara. n barhne ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke electron ki energy zyada hai aur woh nucleus se kam mazbooti se bandha hai.
n se kisi shell ke zyada se zyada electrons bhi nikaal sakte hain: formula 2n². Is liye K, L, M aur N shells mein zyada se zyada 2, 8, 18 aur 32 electrons aa sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek electron ka n = 3 hai. n = 1 wale electron ke muqable mein us ke shell, nucleus se faasle aur energy ke bare mein kya keh sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Woh M shell mein hai, jis mein 18 electrons tak aa sakte hain. Woh n = 1 wale electron se nucleus se zyada door hai, us ka orbital bara hai, energy zyada hai aur woh kam mazbooti se bandha hai.

items: n = 1, 2, 3, 4 (K, L, M, N): orbital ka size aur energy; bara n = bara orbital, zyada energy, kamzor pakar.
Shell mein zyada se zyada 2n² electrons: 2, 8, 18, 32.
